scope: Student HPC exercise: whole-model equivalence to locally frozen original V0; end-to-end performance on the same hardware and environment
quick: --quick: six fixed ShareGPT histories, development only
fusion: No independent operator or hidden-state interface requirement; test real production forward path
benchmark: Same ShareGPT100 inputs/output budgets, timing protocol 4, ITL enabled, no memory polling, batch=1, concurrency=1; baseline and candidate on the same hardware/environment
reference_setup: Student runs freeze on unchanged original V0 before optimization; validate production sources against fixed v0_sources.json (no Git history required), then keep the generated package and manifest pin fixed
submission: One optimization-process document with all optimization stages, correctness results and performance screenshots
measurement_tools_policy: Keep run_benchmark.py, metrics.py and compare_results.py unchanged. benchmark_probe.cu may adapt inference calls only; preserve timing boundaries and completion semantics, warmup, workload and statistics. Document adaptation rationale and code differences.
stage_acceptance: Every reported optimization stage and the final version must run full ShareGPT100 correctness (600 full-vocabulary snapshots) and full ShareGPT100 benchmark on the same code version; retain separate stage results and use the same frozen original V0 reference
optimization_boundary: Inference interfaces and internal kernels, layouts and fusion may change; preserve the computation task, numerical limits and timed work. No required request work may move outside timing boundaries.
correctness_tools_policy: iteration_probe.cu may adapt inference calls only; exercise the actual benchmark inference path and extract full logits at specified positions. Keep reference history, check positions/counts, reference comparison logic and pass criteria unchanged. Document adaptation differences.
